messages.author: bacb0402e67daa77
messages.subject: Help with syntax error [newbie question]
parts:
Hi,

I ran into a syntax error for my RStan code:

ERROR at line 24
 22:    real S2;
 23:    for (i in 1:11) for (j in 1:i)
 24:    S1 = (i-1) * 0.1;
        ^
 25:    S2 = (j-1) * 0.1;

Here is my full code:

library(rstan)
cat ("Stan version:", stan_version(), "\n")

stanmodelcode <- "

data {
    int<lower=1> N; // number of data items = 132
    real y[N]; //data items
}

parameters {
    real<lower=0> expo;
    real<lower=0> semisat;
}

transformed parameters {
    real<lower=0> sigma[N];
    for (n in 1:N)
        sigma[n] <- 0.1 * y[n];
}

model {
    real uhat[N];
    real S1;
    real S2;
    for (i in 1:11) for (j in 1:i)
            S1 = (i-1) * 0.1;
            S2 = (j-1) * 0.1;
            uhat[i + ((i-2) * (i-1)) / 2 + (j-1)] <- S1 ^ expo / (semisat ^ expo + ((S1 ^ 2 + S2 ^ 2) ^ 0.5) ^ expo);
            uhat[66 + i + ((i-2) * (i-1)) / 2 + (j-1)] <- S2 ^ expo / (semisat ^ expo + ((S1 ^ 2 + S2 ^ 2) ^ 0.5) ^ expo);
    for (n in 1:N)
        y[n] ~ normal(uhat[n],sigma);
}
"

And this is what I typed to run:

y <- read.csv("~/Dropbox/spiking/Julia/graphing/u1u2bussearray.csv", quote="\"")
dat <- list(N = 132, y=y);
fit <- stan(model_code = stanmodelcode, model_name="busse",data = dat, iter = 5000, sample_file = "~/test.csv", verbose = TRUE)

I was just wondering where I messed up in defining S1 and S2? 

Thanks.
